Enter at market after a 1-minute close outside the range, until 3 h 15 min after the open. Stop at the middle of the range, a limit target at 3.0x the risk; exit at the NYSE close. Only after a day whose range was the narrowest of the last four.

family_best.title: Bollinger(24,1.6) 240m fade, stop 2.0 ATR, 12 h, high-volume bars only
family_best.rules: Buy a 240-min close under the lower band (short over the upper); target the middle band, stop 2.0 ATR, up to 12 h, high-volume bars only.

family_best.title: RSI(24) 30m fade <30/>70, exit 60, stop 2.5 ATR, 6 h, high-volume bars only
family_best.rules: On 30-min bars buy RSI(24) under 30 (short over 70); exit at 60, after 6 h or at a 2.5 ATR stop, high-volume bars only.

family_best.title: Keltner(EMA20, 1.75 ATR) fade on 240m, stop 3.0 ATR, 8 h
family_best.rules: Fade a 240-min close beyond EMA20 +/- 1.75 ATR; stop 3.0 ATR, up to 8 h.

family_best.title: Sell 15:00 UTC for 9 h, only after a busy hour (weekdays)
family_best.rules: Weekdays at 15:00 UTC sell, only after a busy hour; close 9 h later.

family_best.family: RSI fade by hour and VWAP
family_best.title: RSI(28) 1h fade 35/65 from 18:00 UTC for 14 h, VWAP against, exit 60
family_best.rules: Between 18:00 and 08:00 UTC fade 1h RSI(28) under 35 / over 65, only against price's side of VWAP; exit at 60, 6 h or a 2 ATR stop.

family_best.title: 4h Bollinger(2.0) extreme + 1h RSI(21) 35
family_best.rules: Buy when the 4h close is near its lower band and 1h RSI(21) is under 35 (mirror for shorts); stop 1.0 ATR, up to 6 h.

family_best.title: 4h Bollinger(1.5) extreme + 30m RSI(14) 25
family_best.rules: When the last 4h close is beyond its Bollinger 1.5 band, fade a 30-min RSI(14) extreme (25/75); stop 2.0 ATR, up to 4 h.

family_best.title: EMA20 z-score 2.5 fade on 240m, all day
family_best.rules: Fade price 2.5 standard deviations from its EMA20; exit when it crosses back, after 12 h or at a 2.0 ATR stop.

family_best.title: Friday 00:00 UTC for 6 h, long
family_best.rules: Every Friday buy at 00:00 UTC and close 6 h later.

family_best.title: Fade 0.5 ATR from yesterday's close (60m check), target the anchor, all day
family_best.rules: When a 60-min close is more than 0.5 daily ATR from yesterday's close, trade back toward it; stop 0.5 ATR beyond, to the end of the window.

family_best.title: MFI(21) 240m <30/>70, all day
family_best.rules: Buy MFI(21) under 30 (short over 70); exit at 50, after 8 h or at a 2.0 ATR stop.

family_best.title: Fade 0.5 ATR from the 00:00 UTC open (60m check), target the anchor, all day
family_best.rules: When a 60-min close is more than 0.5 daily ATR from the 00:00 UTC open, trade back toward it; stop 0.5 ATR beyond, to the end of the window.

family_best.title: Pivot fade at R1/S1, all day
family_best.rules: Rest limit orders at the pivot levels; target the pivot (or R1/S1), stop one level further.

family_best.title: Classic pivot fade at level 1, all day
family_best.rules: Rest limit orders at yesterday's classic R1/S1; first touch is the trade.

family_best.title: Williams %R(21) 240m beyond -95/-5, all day
family_best.rules: Buy when %R is under -95 (short over -5); exit at -50, after 8 h or at a 2.0 ATR stop.

family_best.title: Fade a 3.0 ATR move over 6 x 60m
family_best.rules: When price moves more than 3.0 ATR in 6 60-min bars, fade it for 4 h; stop 1.5 ATR.

family_best.title: Fisher(14) 30m fade beyond 2.5, all day
family_best.rules: Fade a 30-min Fisher transform beyond +/-2.5; stop 2.0 ATR, up to 8 h.

family_best.title: US-open 60-min breakout, stop entry, stop at far side, 3R target, with 10-day trend
family_best.rules: Opening range = the first 60 minutes from the NYSE open (13:30 UTC in US summer time, 14:30 in winter), weekdays only. Rest buy-stop and sell-stop orders at the two range edges; the first one touched is the trade, until 3 h 15 min after the open. Stop at the far side of the range, a limit target at 3.0x the risk; exit at the NYSE close. Only in the direction of the last 10 days' move.

family_best.title: Connors RSI 240m <15/>85, exit 50, all day
family_best.rules: Buy Connors RSI under 15 (short over 85); exit at 50, after 4 h or at a 2.0 ATR stop.

family_best.title: Bollinger(20,2.0) 30m breakout, US hours, with trend
family_best.rules: Follow a 30-min close outside the band; stop at 2 ATR, target 1.5R.

family_best.title: Cross-coin reversal at 06:00 UTC, 1 each side, to 00:00
family_best.rules: At 06:00 UTC rank the coins by return over the last 4 h; buy the weakest 1 and sell the strongest 1; close at 00:00 UTC.

family_best.title: DMI(14) cross 60m, ADX>25, European hours, with trend
family_best.rules: Long while +DI is above -DI and ADX is over 25, short the mirror.

family_best.title: US pre-market breakout, retest entry, stop far, target 3R
family_best.rules: Range = 08:00-08:30 New York; trade the break from 08:30 for 2.5 h; exit at the NYSE close.

family_best.title: Stochastic(21) 30m <10/>90, European hours
family_best.rules: Buy when %K is under 10 (short over 90); exit at 50, after 4 h or at a 2.0 ATR stop.

family_best.title: Fade 6 same-colour 30m candles, Asian hours
family_best.rules: After 6 rising (falling) 30-min candles in a row, trade the other way for 4 h; stop 2.0 ATR.

family_best.title: Trend-day follow at 1 h after the NYSE open
family_best.rules: At 1 h after the NYSE open (weekdays), if price has moved at least 0.5 x the 14-day ATR from the 00:00 UTC open, follow the move at market until 00:00 UTC. Stop at the day open. Only in the direction of the last 10 days' move.
